plainLanguage: Section 136 — Repealed. Ufafanuzi huu unafuata vipengele vya statutory text ya R.E. 2022.
meaning: Section 136 is expressly repealed and does not itself create a current substantive offence in this edition.
keyPoints: Do not treat it as creating a current offence.

history.summary: Section 136 appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text verified against the government-hosted R.E. 2022 publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each express element should be established from admissible evidence without expanding the offence beyond the statutory wording.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Consent, age thresholds, defences, complaint limits and sentencing provisions require separate attention where the section expressly includes them.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence na procedure zinatimiza masharti yote ya section 136?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
